mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the mean return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous fall in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE above 3.5% in the same month indicates labor market tightening with weak payroll growth, which increases cost pressures and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below -1% for three consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS above their 12-month moving averages signals increased housing and retail demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in CPIAUCSL below 2% for two consecutive months signals a risk of deflation, which increases real interest rates and discourages investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the mean return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in UNRATE below 3.5% for four consecutive months, combined with a rise in GDPC1 above 2% in the same period, signals a recovery from labor slack without overheating, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% for 4 consecutive months AND GDPC1 > 2% in the same period
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 5% significance.
